act_thesis: Pattern becomes systemic, and the pressure points above the city. The city's holds reach the three through ordinary people's own decisions: Denise cuts Seraphine's caseload after a call from the city, and she works around it by the depot's own procedure (E37). Lucien buys a window with the truth about himself and hears his lie land on Sal (E38); his trap proves only access and costs him Sal's crew and something with Seraphine (E39). The window passes with nothing while civic coordination fails, and Seraphine draws a theory from her limit (E40–E41). She tells Renée the truth once, and it buys nothing back (E44). Care succeeds as care at Inez's gathering and controls nothing (E45); the rebound breaks Seraphine's theory in front of the people she brought, turns shared burden into usable behaviour, and widens the inquiry, not the claim (E46). After the Wide Quiet (E47), Lucien writes the honest account and the three name the next watch as a bet (E48). At the tins they arrive together and Seraphine carries one, at bodily cost: understanding without control (E49). The city knows something is happening; nobody knows enough.

external pressure points above the city: a call from the city reaches Denise, an index card and R.'s note, run logs sent up the line, a copy asked for before the file closed; ordinary people decide for themselves, and the line's "they" stays rumour. act_success_criteria: E37 establishes a changed baseline inside one working day, not an isolated incident; "hum" stays ambiguous (source: S1.T1.B01.A3.E37, from v4.1b E38)

E37–E41 use distinct material failure chains (oxygen deliveries, the police log and a red tag, the food run, transport), not repeated unnamed surges (source: evidence ledger (E38–41 row); census cards B01-40A/B01-40B; S1.T1.B01.A3.E37 to S1.T1.B01.A3.E41)
E38: the window takes two lines and its time is bought; the galley forks are hearsay, similar at most (source: S1.T1.B01.A3.E38, from v4.1b E39)
E40: cohesion breaks through fear, conflicting information and contagion, never mind control; officials unnamed; the "they" is the line's word, never the narrator's (source: S1.T1.B01.A3.E40)
E41 makes aftermath human before any solution; E42 has nothing supernatural in it (source: S1.T1.B01.A3.E41, S1.T1.B01.A3.E42)
The wonder episode (E43) stays unverified wonder: no mechanic, no danger, no report (source: S1.T1.B01.A3.E43; evidence-ledger item E7)
The gathering (E45): care succeeding is not control succeeding (source: S1.T1.B01.A3.E45, from v4.1b E43)

E46 meets its causal card: the plumb line hangs still while Lucien's view will not resolve; Seraphine anchors him; the narrator never links the gathering to the rebound; W3 breaks; inquiry widens, certainty does not (source: CC §4; S1.T1.B01.A3.E46; census card B01-45B)
E46 → E47 → E48 → E49 run with no supplement; E47 is not compressed, has no comedy and is not fully explained (source: S1.T1.B01.A3.E47, from v4.1b E46, §7)
E48: the Square's memory is human; the honest account is one short passage recording the missed middays and the wrong "faster"; the next watch is a bet (source: S1.T1.B01.A3.E48)

E49 meets its causal card: they arrive together by shared work; one stranger (Jody), not a child, is steadied; the whole Square is declined; the cost is bodily; she leaves before her tin moves, Miss Tavie sees it move and cannot say when, and Mrs. Carmouche logs her own post; a quiet, independently checkable observation (source: VAA §4; D6; M03; CC §5; Q-RE6; Q-FX2; S1.T1.B01.A3.E49)

Book-end state: the system is patterned; the city knows something is happening; nobody knows enough. Global extent unconfirmed; vocabulary fragmented (B02 owns pulse) (source: S1.T1.B01.A3.E49; v4.1b §9; VAA §1 E03)
S06 (inside E49) comes after the narrative close: the same room, incompatible stories, no reveal, no cliffhanger (source: S1.T1.B01.A3.E49, from v4.1b S06)
